text: VITAMIN C FOR THE EYES. The texture of this product is a mix between rich cream and serum. It is very soft and absorbs quickly too. It feels very smooth and silky when applying it and a little goes the long way. I definitely felt the burning sensation first couple days of use but then it slowly went away as my skin started tolerating it. It lighted my dark circles in just about a week of use. I will continue to use this product as I definitely think this will reduce my dark wrinkles and fine lines even further over time. This product was the perfect complimentary voxbox for me for my dark circles. I received this for testing purposes.

surprise! it's awesome!. Honestly, for such sensitive skin I have, I was really apprehensive about using this product. Chemical peels and peeling masks tend to do WAY more damage than good. However, this product rocks my world, from the first use. I really love this product and I'm buying the full size version. 100% sold on this.

Amazing and gentle on skin. Great face wash for everyday! It foams up really well and has a lightly pleasant scent but not overwhelming. Just a very nice spa aroma. You literally need a pea-sized amount for your whole face. Once you do, I mix a bit of water and start lathering with my hands to create a foamy texture, then use that to wash my face. I double cleanse (sometimes triple cleanse) and from the initial cleansing phase, I feel like this can remove leftover makeup. I don't think this can be used by itself initially for removing makeup because when I did, there were still some leftover makeup residue left around the eyes. As I noted, when I do triple cleanse with an exfoliating toner, there was absolutely no makeup residue left. Very gentle and non-drying or does not have that tightening feeling when face was towel dried. I loved it so much I got the value size! This one will last for a while though but since I use almost everyday it will run out sooner. Definitely recommend!!!

Incredible next gen formulation. I have dry, dull, easily irritated skin so when I saw the claims of this serum, it was a no-brainer for me. With hydration, less redness, anti-aging, and soothing benefits, I have to admit I was skeptical. The ingredients are top notch, including next generation formulations that I didn't even know existed. After applying, my skin is much more hydrated, has a healthy glow, and feels intensely nourished and less irritated. I've noticed a decrease in redness and dullness, as well as a more even complexion. I'm really impressed so far! This is truly a serum that does it all!

best ordinary product so far. my skin is acne prone and some product aggravate the problem. i am using dofferent products.but this serum really helped alot. my skin is more clearer and bright. acne is also controlled.

This is a serious review! Please read it!. Ok, a little background for you! I am 26 years old and I have been struggling with adult acne for 4 years. I have tried everything out there, and nothing seemed to work. I get facials every month and I have a very rigid skin care regime (I use clarasonic every day, I have oily acne prone skin with enlarged pores, meaning, everything is a concern), but, again, I was still breaking out every other day. Then I decided to change my skin, even if it I had to use acids and peelings. But, right before I switched my regime to a acne fighter with Proactive and acids, I even considered taking powerful medication if needed, I decided to try this product in conjunction with Boscia clear completion cleanser and toner. And, girls, IT WORKED!In less than 2 weeked my skin is CLEAR, that's the first time in years!This is how I do it: I only use it before bed, I wash my face with Boscia cleanser following with the toner. After that, I apply my eye cream and then this lotion ONLY on problematic areas (cite: this product is very potent and it will burn sensitive areas of your face like apples of your chicks and skin around your month that are naturally thinner, so avoid those areas). Use only a very small amount and smooth it until it is invisible, then I apply my night cream over my entire face. DON'T forget to wear sunscreen the next day, since this product makes your skin sensitive to the sun, and please, moisturize your skin at least twice a day because this product tends to dry your skin a little bit.I just can't believe how my skin looks now. But I also know that benzoyl peroxide is not for everyone! Many people who try it have irritations and reactions to this substance, so give it a try, but DO NOT insist if your skin can't handle it.This is incredible product and I can't imagine how my skin looks now!I am completely satisfied with its results!

I wanted to love it!. I wanted so badly to love this! I like the texture of this a lot, and it feels super nice under the eyes (not too oily or thick) BUT after the first night using it, I noticed the next morning that my milia was more pronounced and I had a few little clogged pores around the area where I applied this. GOOD. I really like this cleanser! It's been very calming for my redness. And I've been using this with the oil cleaner and it's been a great combo for my acne and blockheads. I see a a noticeable difference in the mornings. Acne is a lot less red and more subdued.

Great Face Wash. I have weird combination/sensitive skin, which leaves me with a flushed face when irritated. Because of this I have to buy very specific products with non-irritants. I got received this product complimentary to test from Influenster and it's been a  great facewash! It does have a nice scent, but I am not opposed to scented products. It lathers nicely and leaves your skin feeling hydrated and clean without feeling stripped. You also get a lot of product for your buck! Will definitely buy again!

Not Good!. I am an avid toner user, and this is the worst one I've ever used. If you are looking for a straight toner, this product does not perform like a toner. A hydrating essence - yes. First, this product is THICK, not a liquid. Second, it does it absorb fully into the skin, no matter how much time you give it to absorb. This “toner” does not play nice with the rest of my products (serum and moisturizer). It keeps the rest of my products from absorbing, making them sit on top of my skin as well. One of the main purposes of a toner is to make you other products work better—NOT WORSE! The other main purpose of a toner is to balance out your skin- this product made me oily skinned, which I am not. This product is a major fail and maybe should be labeled a hydrating essence, most definitely not a “toner”

. My skin has recently been going through a major crisis with changes in the weather. Everything from dry patches, redness, stinging, basically anything you can think of! I talked to one of the skin specialists and she recommended this product. She suggested I try this and right when I got home, I washed my face and put it on and my skin already feels 200% better. Super moisturized, not heavy or greasy. Just plain moisture!
